+# Question Render Asset Contract v1
+
+Issue: #1101
+Generated: 2026-07-01T06:05:37Z
+
+## Status
+
+This is a repo-local artifact contract for question rendering and source visual
+assets. It is not a database schema, frontend implementation, import job,
+source mutation, or runtime promotion.
+
+## Inputs
+
+- `artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/question-render-source-document-registry.v1.json`
+- `artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/question-render-historical-crop-risk-audit.v1.json`
+- `docs/reports/method-map/2026-07-01-question-render-asset-governance.md`
+
+The historical crop audit scanned 2929 `outputs/screenshots/9709/**/qNN.png`
+files. All 2929 are mapped to registry QP identities, all 2929 retain weak or
+pending source-review posture, 2230 carry suspicious-dimension flags, 192 hash
+groups are duplicated, and 0 rows are display-eligible by default.
+
+## Object Family
+
+### QuestionRenderModel
+
+`QuestionRenderModel` is the default student-facing question content surface.
+It owns the structured text, math, part hierarchy, marks, answer-context notes,
+figure references, source visual receipt references, and render/review status
+for a question or question part.
+
+Whole-question screenshots are fallback/debug/evidence artifacts. They are not
+the default question object and must not be used as a normal structured render.
+
+### SourceFigureAsset
+
+`SourceFigureAsset` is an original source-paper visual object used by a
+structured render. It is not the whole question. It must point to an official
+source document, PDF page, crop bounding box, checksum, dimensions, visual
+review status, usage refs, and source visual receipt refs.
+
+Allowed source figure asset kinds are:
+
+- `diagram`
+- `graph`
+- `chart`
+- `table_image`
+- `layout_fragment`
+- `other`
+
+### FigureAssetIndex
+
+`FigureAssetIndex` is the deterministic index of `SourceFigureAsset` rows for a
+scope. It is not a separate semantic authority. It may answer which source
+visual objects are available for a question or part, but every indexed row must
+still preserve its own review status, checksum, source page, bbox, usage refs,
+and receipt refs.
+
+Minimum index shape:
+
+```text
+schema_version: figure_asset_index.v1
+generated_at
+scope
+source_figure_assets[]
+index_summary
+lineage
+```
+
+### SourceVisualReceipt
+
+`SourceVisualReceipt` is the replayable audit trail linking an original source
+PDF page, a structured render, any source figure assets, and any historical crop
+refs. It supports review and regression checks. It is not a semantic acceptance
+record by itself.
+
+### PedagogicalVisualBlock
+
+`PedagogicalVisualBlock` is a generated or assembled learning visual, such as a
+derivation tree, dependency graph, formula relation map, function plot, or
+misconception overlay. It is not `SourceFigureAsset` and must not pretend to be
+an official paper diagram unless backed by source figure refs.
+
+## Hard Rules
+
+1. QuestionRenderModel is the default student-facing content surface.
+2. Whole-question screenshot display is fallback/debug/evidence only, not the
+   default.
+3. `SourceFigureAsset` is not the whole question. It is the visual object used
+   by a structured render.
+4. `layout_fragment` cannot bypass the structured-render contract unless all
+   fallback fields are present:
+   - explicit fallback reason;
+   - minimal-necessary crop review status;
+   - source visual receipt ref;
+   - fallback display mode;
+   - review status explaining why structured reconstruction is blocked.
+5. Generated learning visuals must be `PedagogicalVisualBlock`, not
+   `SourceFigureAsset`.
+6. Historical `qNN.png` crops remain auxiliary unless a later visual gate
+   accepts them.
+
+## QuestionRenderModel Fidelity Rubric
+
+A `QuestionRenderModel` cannot pass merely because it exists. It must satisfy
+these checks before any student-facing consumption gate can treat it as usable:
+
+| check | requirement |
+| --- | --- |
+| identity and hierarchy | subject, paper, session, year, variant, question number, part, and subpart hierarchy match the source paper |
+| marks and command words | marks and command words are present and bound to the correct prompt block or part |
+| answer-critical terms | variables, units, options, intervals, domains, and figure refs are present |
+| math round trip | math source can round-trip through the intended renderer without semantic loss |
+| layout semantics | tables and lists preserve answer-critical structure |
+| source refs | refs point to official source documents, pages, spans, or bboxes where available |
+| visual dependencies | required original-paper visuals are represented by `SourceFigureAsset` refs or explicit blockers |
+| fallback honesty | fallback image mode is explicit, rare, reviewable, and backed by source receipts |

+
+Whole-question screenshots are fallback/debug/evidence artifacts. They are not
+the default question object and must not be used as a normal structured render.
+
+### SourceFigureAsset
+
+`SourceFigureAsset` is an original source-paper visual object used by a
+structured render. It is not the whole question. It must point to an official
+source document, PDF page, crop bounding box, checksum, dimensions, visual
+review status, usage refs, and source visual receipt refs.
+
+Allowed source figure asset kinds are:
+
+- `diagram`
+- `graph`
+- `chart`
+- `table_image`
+- `layout_fragment`
+- `other`
+
+### FigureAssetIndex
+
+`FigureAssetIndex` is the deterministic index of `SourceFigureAsset` rows for a
+scope. It is not a separate semantic authority. It may answer which source
+visual objects are available for a question or part, but every indexed row must
+still preserve its own review status, checksum, source page, bbox, usage refs,
+and receipt refs.
+
+Minimum index shape:
+
+```text
+schema_version: figure_asset_index.v1
+generated_at
+scope
+source_figure_assets[]
+index_summary
+lineage
+```
+
+### SourceVisualReceipt
+
+`SourceVisualReceipt` is the replayable audit trail linking an original source
+PDF page, a structured render, any source figure assets, and any historical crop
+refs. It supports review and regression checks. It is not a semantic acceptance
+record by itself.
+
+### PedagogicalVisualBlock
+
+`PedagogicalVisualBlock` is a generated or assembled learning visual, such as a
+derivation tree, dependency graph, formula relation map, function plot, or
+misconception overlay. It is not `SourceFigureAsset` and must not pretend to be
+an official paper diagram unless backed by source figure refs.
+
+## Hard Rules
+
+1. QuestionRenderModel is the default student-facing content surface.
+2. Whole-question screenshot display is fallback/debug/evidence only, not the
+   default.
+3. `SourceFigureAsset` is not the whole question. It is the visual object used
+   by a structured render.
+4. `layout_fragment` cannot bypass the structured-render contract unless all
+   fallback fields are present:
+   - explicit fallback reason;
+   - minimal-necessary crop review status;
+   - source visual receipt ref;
+   - fallback display mode;
+   - review status explaining why structured reconstruction is blocked.
+5. Generated learning visuals must be `PedagogicalVisualBlock`, not
+   `SourceFigureAsset`.
+6. Historical `qNN.png` crops remain auxiliary unless a later visual gate
+   accepts them.
+
+## QuestionRenderModel Fidelity Rubric
+
+A `QuestionRenderModel` cannot pass merely because it exists. It must satisfy
+these checks before any student-facing consumption gate can treat it as usable:
+
+| check | requirement |
+| --- | --- |
+| identity and hierarchy | subject, paper, session, year, variant, question number, part, and subpart hierarchy match the source paper |
+| marks and command words | marks and command words are present and bound to the correct prompt block or part |
+| answer-critical terms | variables, units, options, intervals, domains, and figure refs are present |
+| math round trip | math source can round-trip through the intended renderer without semantic loss |
+| layout semantics | tables and lists preserve answer-critical structure |
+| source refs | refs point to official source documents, pages, spans, or bboxes where available |
+| visual dependencies | required original-paper visuals are represented by `SourceFigureAsset` refs or explicit blockers |
+| fallback honesty | fallback image mode is explicit, rare, reviewable, and backed by source receipts |

Fixed in follow-up PR #1112, merged at 3f68aef74: schema `required` arrays are sorted lexicographically, including the top-level QuestionRenderModel required list.
Fixed in follow-up PR #1112, merged at 3f68aef74: schema `required` arrays are sorted lexicographically, including the PedagogicalVisualBlock required list.
